$comment: Shared contract between the editor's C# checker and the browser checker (pdf.js). Authoritative copy: testdata/redaction-corpus/redaction-check-spec.json in the abyo PDF Editor repository; the browser checker mirrors it. Both implementations load THIS file for thresholds; neither hard-codes a number. Changing any value bumps specVersion. Values agreed 2026-10-20; see docs/design/disclosure-redaction/design.md section 8.

units.length: PDF points in the page's user space after CTM and clipping, before /Rotate; origin bottom-left (rect = x0,y0,x1,y1 with x0<x1, y0<y1)
units.luminance: L = 0.2126 R + 0.7152 G + 0.0722 B on 0..1 components as written in the PDF (no gamma decoding). DeviceGray g -> R=G=B=g. DeviceCMYK -> R=(1-C)(1-K), G=(1-M)(1-K), B=(1-Y)(1-K). ICCBased/CalRGB/Lab: use the alternate/N-component rule above. Indexed: look up the base. Separation/DeviceN: tint transform when available, else treat as unknown (not a candidate, record in checksSkipped detail).

verdicts.fileVerdict: worst finding verdict; pass when there are no findings. A check listed in checksSkipped never yields pass for that check; the report must show it.

wording.pass: 検査した{n}項目で問題は見つかりませんでした

drawOrder.rule: Page content stream(s) in order, with every Form XObject expanded at its Do (recursively, including nested forms, patterns are NOT expanded), then each annotation's normal appearance (/AP /N, honouring /F hidden and /OC off) in /Annots order. Annotations are always above page content.

candidate.$comment: A 'cover candidate' (黒塗り候補). Evaluated on the EFFECTIVE region: shape transformed by CTM and intersected with the current clip.

size.$comment: Agreed: short side >= 3pt and long side >= 6pt, no area rule. A single masked digit at 8pt is about 5x8pt and must qualify. Thin rules (< 3pt) stay excluded; draw order removes header bands and table fills.

rectangularity.$comment: Oriented (minimum-area) bounding box, so rotated rectangles qualify.

strokedPath.$comment: marker-style blackouts drawn with a thick stroke; region = stroke outline

image.$comment: an image counts as a cover candidate over the area where >= 95% of its decoded pixels are dark. ImageMask: candidate when the fill colour is dark. An image whose codec the implementation cannot decode is NOT a candidate; see imageDecoding.

nonDarkOpaqueCover.$comment: An opaque NON-dark fill drawn over earlier text also hides it (white-box cover, grey redaction box). Reported as A1 review, not fail, to avoid failing Excel-style cell overflow.

glyphBox.rule: x from the glyph origin to origin + advance (Tw/Tc/Tz applied); y from baseline + descent to baseline + ascent with a FIXED ascent of 0.8 em and descent of -0.2 em; then transformed by Tm x CTM. Both implementations MUST use this box, not ink bounds, so coverage fractions agree.
glyphBox.$comment: FontDescriptor /Ascent and /Descent are deliberately NOT read: pdf.js and PDFium expose them differently and missing/zero values are common, so a fixed box is the only one both engines compute identically.

imageDecoding.rule: When an implementation cannot decode an image's data (typically /DCTDecode, /JPXDecode, /JBIG2Decode or /CCITTFaxDecode, depending on the engine), every check that needs that image's pixels yields REVIEW for the affected region, never pass, and the report adds a checksSkipped entry.
imageDecoding.$comment: <Filter> is the terminal filter name without the slash, e.g. image-codec-not-decodable:DCTDecode. Such an image is also not a cover candidate (its darkness is unknown). Corpus cases whose verdict depends on this carry expect.acceptVerdicts.

checks.title: 不透明な図形・画像の下に取り出せるテキスト
checks.rule: glyph drawn before a candidate with coveredFraction(glyphBox, candidate) >= coverFail

checks.title: 黒塗りが文字に一部しかかかっていない
checks.rule: coverPartialMin <= coveredFraction < coverFail for a glyph drawn before a candidate

checks.title: 未適用の /Redact、または注釈で隠している
checks.rule: any /Redact annotation (regardless of what is under it); or an annotation appearance that is a candidate and covers text (coveredFraction >= coverPartialMin); /Highlight with opaque dark appearance counts

checks.title: 白文字・背景同色・ページ外・クリップ外の文字
checks.rule: text whose |L(text) - L(background)| < hiddenContrast, where background = colour painted at the glyph centre BEFORE the text (paper white when nothing): FAIL regardless of proximity. Glyph box outside the CropBox, or fully clipped out: FAIL when within nearCandidatePt of a candidate, else REVIEW. Tr 3 text is A5, not A4.
checks.imageBackground: when the topmost painter under the glyph centre is an image, background = mean luminance of the image pixels under the glyph box; if the image cannot be decoded: REVIEW plus checksSkipped {check:"A4", reason:"image-codec-not-decodable:<Filter>"} (see imageDecoding), never pass

checks.title: 黒塗りの下の不可視テキスト（Tr 3）
checks.rule: Tr 3 (or 7) glyph with coveredFraction >= coverPartialMin under a candidate (glyph box, not run origin)

checks.title: 画像の上に黒い図形を重ねただけ
checks.rule: image drawn, then a candidate over it, AND the decoded image pixels under the candidate are NOT dark (darkPixelFraction < candidate.image.minDarkPixelFraction). Pixels already dark = the image was really redacted (Acrobat / this editor) -> no finding. Image not decodable by the implementation: REVIEW plus checksSkipped {check:"A6", reason:"image-codec-not-decodable:<Filter>"} (see imageDecoding), never pass.

checks.title: 増分更新の旧版に別の内容
checks.rule: walk startxref/Prev to list revisions; for each earlier revision, extract text per page; fail when an earlier revision has text not present in the final revision, review when revisions exist but cannot be parsed

checks.title: 構造ツリーの /ActualText・/Alt に黒塗り部分の文字
checks.rule: /ActualText, /Alt or /E on a struct element or BDC property list whose content (MCIDs, or the element's page area) intersects a candidate, OR whose string is not found in the page's extractable text while the page has candidates; else listed under A9 as review

checks.title: 文書情報・XMP・しおり・添付・フォーム値・注釈本文・非表示レイヤー・サムネイル
checks.rule: list every non-empty item with its content (for the screen only; the saved report keeps item kind and count, not the value)

checks.title: 画像だけのページ
checks.rule: page with no extractable text and at least one image covering >= imageOnlyCoverage of the CropBox

checks.title: 暗号化されていて検査できない
checks.rule: the file is encrypted and could not be opened with an empty user password (and no password was supplied)

recovered.$comment: text found under the cover. SCREEN ONLY: never written to a saved report, a log, or a file, by either implementation

evidence.$comment: machine-comparable facts: coveredFraction, candidateSource, luminance, revisionIndex, ...

reason.$comment: free text, except the fixed form image-codec-not-decodable:<Filter> (imageDecoding)

notInspected.$comment: fixed sentences, e.g. 画像の中に写った文字の内容は読み取っていない

manifest.$comment: testdata/redaction-corpus/manifest.json: an object {specVersion, note, cases[]} (the browser checker's shape, adopted as is). Harnesses skip a case whose file is absent only when it is marked pending.

verdict.$comment: the verdict of an implementation that decodes every image

checks.$comment: check ids that MUST be raised

mustNotFlag.$comment: check ids whose appearance is a false positive

acceptVerdicts.$comment: ONLY for codec-dependent cases (imageDecoding): the verdicts accepted from an implementation that cannot decode the case's image. Must contain verdict, and may not add pass.

editorOnly.$comment: the browser checker may skip it; its verdict expectation still applies to the editor's checker

pending.$comment: the file is not in the corpus yet (e.g. needs Acrobat); harnesses report it as absent and skip it. A case whose file exists must not be pending.

madeBy.$comment: for source abyo-editor/acrobat: how the file was produced
